faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Theni Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Counsellor post is 01 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Counsellor post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18536 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Counsellor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, Public Health, or Counselling, or possess a PG Diploma in Counselling and Communication.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any work experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have at least 1 year of working experience with a Government or NGO, preferably in the field of Women & Child Development.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Counsellor position is 42 years.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DCPU Theni Counsellor job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DCPU Theni, which is theni.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Counsellor position is Contractual.
